key: # Import this file to Google Sheets as a tab named "config". The workflows read
# every setting below at runtime so you rarely touch the workflow JSON again.
# Add two more tabs in the same spreadsheet: "queue" and "log" (headers at bottom).

notes: Engine 1 (CC clipping). ON or OFF.
Engine 2 (AI-generated). ON or OFF.
ON = send Telegram preview and wait for approval before posting. OFF = fully auto. Start ON for the dry run.
ON = add synthetic-media disclosure to AI-generated posts (Engine 2). Keep ON.
Short label for your channel niche.

value: artificial intelligence; machine learning; AI tools; tech explainer
notes: Semicolon-separated. Drives both the CC finder and AI topic discovery.
One-line description of tone for scripts and captions.
Content language (ISO code).
'search' = auto-find CC videos by keyword. 'channels' = only the fixed channel IDs below.
Optional. Semicolon-separated YouTube channel IDs you OWN or are licensed to clip. Used when clip_source_mode=channels.
Ignore source videos shorter than this (want long-form to clip).
Max new source videos processed per scheduled run (cost + cadence control).
opusclip | vizard | klap | openshorts — must match the clipping credential you set up.
How many shorts to cut from each source video.
'cheap' = stock + TTS + FFmpeg/Creatomate. 'premium' = AI video (Veo/HeyGen). 'premium' costs more — see docs/COSTS.md.
kokoro (free, self-host) | elevenlabs (paid).
Only used when ai_visual_mode=premium. veo_lite | veo_standard | heygen.
Target length for generated shorts.
Max generated videos per scheduled run (cost control).
Idea-engine tops the queue tab back up to this many unused topics.
upload-post | blotato — must match the posting credential you set up.
Semicolon-separated targets: youtube; tiktok; instagram; facebook; x; linkedin; threads; pinterest; bluesky.
Cadence cap per platform. Keep modest (anti-spam).
Minimum spacing between posts to the same platform.
Appended to captions; prompt packs add niche-specific ones.
Optional. Affiliate link / call-to-action added to descriptions. e.g. 'Free AI toolkit: https://...'
How often each engine's schedule trigger fires.
IANA timezone for scheduling, e.g. America/New_York.
telegram | slack | none — where health alerts and quality-gate previews go.
